purpose: W6-B: define an ATI reference adapter for board, auction, order, webhook, tracking and document capabilities over the provider-neutral Logistics authority without leaking ATI-specific semantics into core Shipment/Deal models or claiming live access.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. This staged branch has zero implementation authority until separate governance review/merge and immutable scope promotion.
requiredInvariants: Core logistics remains provider-neutral. ATI identifiers, statuses, board/auction concepts and webhook payload fields are normalized at the adapter boundary and never become canonical Shipment state directly.

Capabilities are explicit: BOARD_PUBLISH, CARRIER_AUCTION, ORDER_CREATE, WEBHOOK_RECEIVE, TRACKING_READ and DOCUMENT_EXCHANGE. Missing capability fails closed and cannot silently use another ATI surface.
An ATI board post or auction is a logistics sourcing projection, not a Deal/Shipment/payment authority. Canonical provider/own-fleet selection and Shipment creation remain in W4-A.

ATI order creation requires an already authorized canonical logistics selection/basis, exact shipment terms and payload-bound idempotency. Browser-provided ATI identity/status never creates core authority.
Webhook verification binds provider account, signing/secret key version, event id, payload fingerprint, timestamp/freshness and replay protection before mapping any fact.

Tracking points are append-only provider observations with source timestamp and precision/provenance; they cannot manufacture physical admission, delivery acceptance or legal custody without canonical policy.

ATI document exchange maps provider references to canonical document requirements/receipts but cannot mark ETRN/EPD/other documents signed, delivered or accepted without validated provider/signature/EDO evidence.

Outbound request acceptance/queueing is not ATI success. Only validated immutable provider receipts may update integration state, and canonical logistics state changes occur through accepted core commands.
Adapter remains NOT_ACTIVATED without real API contract, credentials, base URLs, webhook secret/key and validated production mapping; tests must never report live ATI success.
Errors, rate limits, unsupported operations and provider outages produce explicit degraded/fail-closed states with retryable durable integration evidence, never process-memory authority.
No new mandatory recurring cost, credential or secret is committed by the staged/reference adapter work.
Registration, Role Eligibility, W2/W3/W4 core authorities, Federal Accounting lock #4321 and REG.RU-only production remain unchanged.
acceptance: Adapter contract tests prove all six ATI capability surfaces map to provider-neutral request/receipt models and ATI fields do not enter canonical Shipment types.
Reference adapter is NOT_ACTIVATED without credentials/config and cannot fabricate board/order/tracking/document success.
Webhook replay, wrong secret/key, stale timestamp, account/provider mismatch and payload mutation fail closed.
Tracking mapping preserves source timestamps/provenance and cannot directly advance delivery/acceptance state.
Order/board/auction requests require canonical authorized logistics basis and exact idempotency; duplicate/conflicting requests are deterministic.
Document mapping cannot promote provider document availability to signed/delivered/accepted without validated canonical receipts.
No core Deal/Shipment/Settlement mutation is introduced in the reference adapter foundation.
Exact-head review and credentialed REG.RU ATI acceptance remain mandatory before any ATI terminal criterion receives PASS.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Actual ATI API contract/credentials/endpoints/webhook registration and production mapping are external dependencies.
W4-A Logistics must consume adapter sourcing/order/tracking evidence before terminal integration credit.
EDO/EPD/transport-document legal validation remains W6-C/W5-B and is not proven by ATI document transport alone.
Real production error/rate-limit/reconciliation evidence on REG.RU remains required.
